title: Date from which the new address is valid
goal: HR knows from which date to use the new address, for example for payslips sent on the 25th, and late reports are accepted only within three months.
context: HR said that without the valid-from date "I can't do anything" (F-TR-018), because it decides which address is used, for example for payslips that go out on the 25th (F-TR-007, F-TR-008). People often report late, so past dates must be accepted, but not more than three months back (F-TR-019, F-TR-021). Dates use the format DD.MM.YYYY (G-02). Still open: whether future dates have a limit (OQ-04), exactly how 'three months ago' is counted, and what happens to reports made more than three months late (OQ-05).

stories.title: Every address change states the date from which the new address is valid
stories.i_want: every reported change of address to include the date from which the new address is valid
stories.so_that: I know which address to use from when, for example for the payslips that go out on the 25th
stories.priority_reason: HR said that without this date "I can't do anything" - the address change cannot be processed and payslips may go to the wrong address (F-TR-018, F-TR-008).

acceptance_criteria.title: The valid-from date is always asked and cannot be left empty
acceptance_criteria.given: an employee reports a change of address, whether within Switzerland or abroad
acceptance_criteria.when: they give the details of their move
acceptance_criteria.then: they are always asked from which date the new address is valid, and the report cannot be completed without this date

acceptance_criteria.title: The date is given as a calendar date in the form DD.MM.YYYY
acceptance_criteria.given: an employee gives the date from which the new address is valid
acceptance_criteria.when: the date is shown back to them or passed on
acceptance_criteria.then: it is a single calendar day written as DD.MM.YYYY, for example 01.12.2026

acceptance_criteria.title: HR receives the valid-from date together with the new address
acceptance_criteria.given: an employee has completed a change of address report
acceptance_criteria.then: HR sees the date from which the new address is valid next to the new address, so it can decide which address applies, for example for the payslips sent on the 25th

stories.title: Report a move late, but at most three months back
stories.i_want: to give a valid-from date in the past when I report my move late, as long as it is not more than three months ago
stories.so_that: I can still report my move correctly even if I did not do it on time, while HR is not confronted with address changes from long ago
stories.priority_reason: HR reports that people often tell them late (F-TR-021); without accepting past dates these employees could not report their move at all.

acceptance_criteria.title: Past dates within the last three months and today are accepted
acceptance_criteria.given: an employee reports a move late
acceptance_criteria.when: they give a valid-from date that is today or within the last three months before the day of reporting

acceptance_criteria.title: Dates more than three months in the past are not accepted
acceptance_criteria.given: an employee reports a move very late
acceptance_criteria.when: they give a valid-from date more than three months before the day of reporting
acceptance_criteria.then: the date is not accepted and the employee is told that the date may be at most three months in the past. What the employee should do next, and whether the exact day three months ago counts as accepted, is still open (OQ-05)

acceptance_criteria.title: Future dates are accepted
acceptance_criteria.given: an employee reports a move in advance
acceptance_criteria.when: they give a valid-from date after the day of reporting
acceptance_criteria.then: the date is accepted; no upper limit for future dates has been stated (OQ-04)
